verdict.rationale: The reemployment tax eServices page documents a file-number entry path: entering a Reemployment Tax Number and FEIN/ITIN to Start a New Return, Resume a Saved Return or Make a Payment (Direct File, formerly SecureNet), plus a number-based Document Lookup. However, the founder's first step, registering through the Florida Business Tax Application, is shown by probe to sit behind a login/authenticated session, and that registration is what supplies the tax number the keyless path needs. Missing for 10: an account-free registration/start path, fuller documentation of the Direct File no-login flow beyond page labels, and independent or hands-on confirmation that filing works without a User ID.
